title: Introduction To Peace And Conflict Resolution
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a by-product of oil extraction, which is removed from the earth crust along with the crude oil."
Natural gas is a by-product of oil extraction, which is removed from the earth crust along with the crude oil.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the deliberate burning of natural gas that is produced in the Niger Delta; it creates a ceaseless, high intensity flame."
Gas flaring is the deliberate burning of natural gas that is produced in the Niger Delta; it creates a ceaseless, high intensity flame.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex phenomenon which has always been associated with political, religious, juridical and other social aspects of human existence."
Ethnicity is a complex phenomenon which has always been associated with political, religious, juridical and other social aspects of human existence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an act characterised by rudeness, hooliganism, touting, intimidation and harassment."
Thuggery is an act characterised by rudeness, hooliganism, touting, intimidation and harassment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex society with a multiplicity of religious and cultural allegiances and sensibilities."
Nigeria is a complex society with a multiplicity of religious and cultural allegiances and sensibilities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a state of mind in concourse with serenity, a state of harmony, tranquillity, concord and a balance of equilibrium of powers."
Peace is a state of mind in concourse with serenity, a state of harmony, tranquillity, concord and a balance of equilibrium of powers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a must for peace as a social contract underlying a structure of social expectations and associated social cooperation."
The balance of power is a must for peace as a social contract underlying a structure of social expectations and associated social cooperation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the close proximity of gas flares to residential areas, forests, and waterways, thereby making living unbearable to human beings, terrestrial and aquatic animals."
Compounding the people's plight is the close proximity of gas flares to residential areas, forests, and waterways, thereby making living unbearable to human beings, terrestrial and aquatic animals.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an illegitimate and violent means of seeking political power with a view to subverting national opinion for parochial ends through self-imposition."
Political thuggery is an illegitimate and violent means of seeking political power with a view to subverting national opinion for parochial ends through self-imposition.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an unavoidable process through which people interact and achieve their set goals in the area of their interest."
Politics is an unavoidable process through which people interact and achieve their set goals in the area of their interest.

primary stake holders
